summary: @servicetitan/forge preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 700KB payload
details: The package's package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from oven-sh/bun GitHub release assets, extracts and chmods the bun binary in a temp directory, and then execFileSyncs it against a package-local file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled blob marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` and obfuscated with a canonical string-array shuffle (WV8StW / MmgoCP.shift loop) and hex identifiers. setup.mjs itself is transformed by an obfuscator.io-style pass with `_0xNNNNNN` identifiers and per-function three-letter string dispatch tables (YCZJE, HWsee, WaLKQ, etc.), hiding the control flow and string literals. The declared purpose of the package is a React UI component library; shipping and executing an opaque, obfuscated, Bun-compiled 700KB payload at install time is unrelated to any UI-library function. Pulling an alternate runtime to execute an obfuscated sibling file at install time is a known dropper pattern that evades Node-based static scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
